users.usernameHint: Optional. Signs in like the email. 3 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
users.usernameInvalid: Use 3 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or digit
users.usernameTaken: Another user already has this username
users.usernameHintRequired: Signs in like the email. 3 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
users.emailTaken: Another user already has this email
users.emailHint: They are signed out everywhere and links sent before stop working. The new address gets a link to confirm it; the old one is told.
users.emailHintInvited: The invitation is sent again to the new address. The link sent before stops working.
users.emailOptionalHint: Optional. Without one, only an administrator can reset this person's password.
users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Invite people, manage their access and sign-in security.
users.inviteText: They get an email with a link to set their password.
users.devLink: Email is not configured in development, so share this link yourself.
users.createText: They can sign in right away with this temporary password and must choose their own at the first sign-in. No email is sent.
users.setTempText: Their current password stops working and they are signed out everywhere. They must choose a new password at the next sign-in.
users.handOver: Give this password to {name} yourself. It is not shown again.
users.handOverUntil: It works until {when}. After that, set a new one.
users.handOverHours: It works for 72 hours. After that, set a new one.
users.mfaAsked: Sign-in asks for a code while a method is set up, even when two-step verification is not required.
users.resetMfaText: Their methods and recovery codes are removed and they are signed out everywhere. The next sign-in needs only the password.
users.resetMfaTextRequired: Their methods and recovery codes are removed and they are signed out everywhere. They set up two-step verification again at the next sign-in.
users.name: Name
users.mfaRequiredHint: They must set it up at their next sign-in.
users.disableText: They are signed out everywhere and can't sign in until you enable them again.
users.revokeText: All their sessions end. They can sign in again.
users.effectiveHint: From direct roles and group roles together. Conditional policies are not included.
users.superText: Super administrators can do everything, including what no role grants.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: What each role may do. Changes apply at the next request.
roles.name: Name
roles.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Can't be changed later.
roles.keyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
roles.deleteText: Users and groups with this role lose its permissions.
roles.changes: {n} change in {roles} role(s) | {n} changes in {roles} role(s)
roles.saved: Saved {n} change across {roles} role(s) | Saved {n} changes across {roles} role(s)

stats.superUsers: {n} bypasses every check | {n} bypass every check

matrix.caption: Permissions by role
matrix.sensitiveTip: Sensitive: deleting records or changing access is hard to undo.
matrix.hint: Click a cell, or use the arrow keys and Space. The count on a resource row grants or revokes all its actions.

roles.policiesHint: Policies allow or deny actions on a resource, optionally only when a condition holds. A deny wins over an allow.

policyList.noMatchText: Clear a filter or create a policy.
policyList.emptyText: A policy allows or denies actions on the records that match a condition.

test.title: Test access
test.hint: Checks the saved roles and policies together with this policy as it is now. Unsaved changes in the permission matrix are not included.
test.recordHint: Fields left unset are unknown to the check.
test.finish: Finish the policy to test it.
test.unknown: Its condition can't be decided from these values.

step.fence_denied: The record belongs to another tenant.
step.super_allowed: {role} is a super administrator role: it passes every check.
step.deny_skipped: The deny policy {policy} ({role}) doesn't match this record.
step.permission_allowed: The role {role} grants {key} for every record.
step.allow_skipped: The allow policy {policy} ({role}) doesn't match this record.
step.none_denied: No role grants {key} and no allow policy matches.

policy.rolesHint: Each role gets its own copy of the policy.
policy.roleFixed: A policy belongs to one role. To apply it to another role, create it there.
policy.allowHelp: Allow adds access to the records that match, even for a role without the permission.
policy.denyHelp: Deny removes access to the records that match. It wins over any permission or allow policy.
policy.savedMany: Policy created for {n} role | Policy created for {n} roles
policy.name: Name
policy.conditionHint: The policy applies only to records that match.
policy.noCondition: No condition: the policy applies to every record.

review.title: Review access changes
review.text: Takes effect on each user's next request.
review.risk: Deleting records or changing access settings is hard to undo.
review.understand: I understand these grants are hard to undo

groups.title: Groups
groups.subtitle: People who share roles, such as a team or department.
groups.name: Name
groups.searchMembers: Search members by name or email…
groups.deleteText: Members lose the roles they had through this group.

stats.ofTypes: of {n} record type | of {n} record types

workflows.title: Approval workflows
workflows.subtitle: Who approves which records, in which order.
workflows.newHint: Start with a name; add stages and approvers next.
workflows.name: Name
workflows.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Can't be changed later.
workflows.keyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
workflows.basedOn: Editing a draft based on version {n}

diagram.label: Diagram
diagram.hint: Stages run left to right; the steps in a stage run in parallel. Click a step to see or change it.
diagram.insertStage: Insert a stage after this one
diagram.removeStageText: The stage and its {n} step(s) leave the draft. Nothing is saved until you save a new version.

workflows.activateText: New requests use it at once. Requests already running keep their version.
workflows.activateVersionText: New requests will use version {n}. Requests already running keep their version.
workflows.stageHint: Steps in a stage run in parallel; the next stage starts when this one is done.

rules.allowSelfApprovalHint: The submitter may approve their own request.
rules.rejectEndsRequestHint: Always on: one rejection rejects the whole request.

workflows.descriptionHint: Shown to people choosing a workflow when they submit.
workflows.defaultHint: Used when the submitter doesn't choose.
workflows.defaultNeedsLive: Only a live workflow can be the default.
workflows.deactivateText: New requests can't use it. Requests already open keep going on their version.
workflows.deleteText: It leaves the list and cannot be brought back. Requests that ran on it keep their history. The key {key} cannot be used for another workflow.
workflows.shippedEdited: This workflow differs from the version shipped with the app.
workflows.shippedInactive: This workflow shipped with the app is turned off.
workflows.shippedOutdated: A newer shipped version is applied on the next update.
workflows.useShippedConfirm: Publish the version shipped with the app as a new version and make it live?

jobs.title: Background jobs
jobs.subtitle: Work that runs outside requests: imports, exports, emails and schedules.
jobs.name: Job
jobs.emptyText: Jobs show up here when they are queued.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who did what, and when. Events can't be changed.
audit.filterHint: Select an ID to filter the log by it.
audit.notOnPage: This event isn't on the current page

menuMap.title: Menu map
menuMap.subtitle: Every menu item, where it comes from and who sees it. Read-only: change access on the Roles page.
menuMap.pickHint: Pick a role or a user to see what their menu shows and why an item is hidden.
menuMap.noChildren: No page, and none of its children are shown

brand.subtitle: The name, logo and slogan people see. Empty fields and unused uploads keep what the app ships.
brand.textsHint: Each text in English and Lao. A Lao reader sees the Lao text, else the English one, else what the app ships.
brand.imagesHint: PNG, WebP or JPEG up to 1 MB. Switch each image between the one the app ships and your upload.
brand.titlePatternHint: {page} is the page title, {name} the app name.

slots.logoDarkHint: Used instead of the logo in dark mode
slots.markHint: Square; the collapsed sidebar and the installed app

brand.loadFailed: The brand could not be loaded
brand.loadFailedText: Saving is off until it loads, so the saved brand is not replaced by an empty one.
